purpose: Lock mobile 4X interaction flow and hierarchy before visual implementation.

entry.behavior: single clear tap changes to dedicated World screen; no gate-walk animation required

worldHome.camera: fixed isometric/top-down direction; bounded pan and bounded zoom

selection.opens: compact context panel anchored safely inside mobile frame

marchFeedback.before: optional confirmation only when composition/choice matters
marchFeedback.outbound: visible marker leaves Valoria and travels toward target
marchFeedback.completion: reward feedback occurs when authoritative return completes

return.behavior: returns to certified Valoria city screen and preserves shared state

mobileRules: pan gesture must not accidentally select POIs
tap must not trigger after a drag threshold is exceeded
context panels must not cover the selected target if avoidable
home/reset camera affordance if user loses orientation
far zoom must preserve city/resource/PvE silhouettes
UI labels support recognition but cannot compensate for unreadable world silhouettes
